test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **With**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **With **is the correct preposition to use when talking about being accompanied or having something in your possession.
 
• In this case, the blank is asking for the appropriate preposition to use.
 
 
• **Example**: *I am filling out a form with my friend.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**For**" is often used to indicate purpose or reason.
 
• "**On**" is often used to indicate location or topic.
 
• "**At**" is often used to indicate a specific time or place.
